name: fivedrisk
description: 5D Risk Governance Engine for Claude Code. A deterministic all-tool PreToolUse hook scores each call on 5 dimensions (Data, Tool, Reversibility, External, Autonomy): GREEN/YELLOW allow, ORANGE emits Claude's structured ask decision, and RED denies. An all-tool PostToolUse hook scans output aliases for leakage/injection-echo. Every decision is logged to a local SQLite audit trail. No LLM in the decision path. Hooks require an explicit verified FIVEDRISK_PYTHON; custom policies use FIVEDRISK_POLICY_PATH.
